page.content:
Michael Myers and Haddonfield — the slasher calendar's most durable myth.

How Halloween connects

  • Artist: John Carpenter — John Carpenter created Halloween as director, co-writer, and composer.
  • Work: Halloween (1978) — Halloween (1978) is the film that starts the franchise.
  • Work: Halloween II — Halloween II continues the original night into the hospital.
  • Work: Halloween (2018) — Halloween (2018) is a direct sequel to 1978.
  • Artist: Debra Hill — Hill produced the original Halloween and helped launch the cycle.
  • Work: Halloween Ends — Halloween Ends closes the 2018 Laurie trilogy.

What is Halloween?

Halloween is the slasher cycle that begins with John Carpenter's 1978 film: Michael Myers escapes, walks Haddonfield on October 31, and is met by Laurie Strode and Dr. Loomis. Later films, reboots, and the 2018–2022 trilogy keep returning to that night and its survivors.

Key threads lead to John Carpenter, Halloween (1978), Halloween II, Halloween (2018), Debra Hill and Halloween Ends.
